reviews.x: My first time using this set took me back to summers as a kid when I used to visit my grandmother in India. I always knew when it was bathtime because my grandmother would light a fire in the courtyard and boil water for the bath in a giant black witch cauldron. She would then bathe me by pouring scalding hot water over me as I screamed and cried. I thought I had left those painful bath times behind me.... until I purchased this brush set. Mama, you best be in for the exfoliation of your LIFE be

reviews.t: A great set if brushes that do a great job
reviews.x: The delivery came in, on time, with no damages to the box or any items inside of it. Please refer to the photo in order to see what I received. Please note, this is after a few uses. The brushes are in perfect condition. There were no scratches, missing bristles, or any other damages on the items at all.  Upon feeling each of the brushes in my hands (yes, that is my hand), the shorter hand brush fit like a glove. The strap on the back gives me the support needed to give my body a deep scrubbing.

So I decided to try this dry brushing a shot to see if it really helps with skin appearance and cellulite.  The brushes are nice and sturdy. No flakes of brush hair  falling off. I like the wand as it allows me to reach my back! I looked up a map of the body how to correctly  brush the body, it's  actually  very satisfying!

These are okay brushes for the price. There was quite a bit of bristles falling out from the brush before I could even open the package. However, even with that fallout there still looked like there was a bunch of bristles so as long as they don't continue to fall out I think it's fine. If you're looking for a soft brush this isn't it, the bristles are very firm and scratches easily, so you have to use a pretty light touch. The presentation is as the picture shows, nice wood and the hangers look

The great thing about the brushes are the two sizes with different handles. The long loofa is great for my back and legs while the smaller brush can be hand held and used for my arms and neck. The brushes are very durable and the exfoliation is great, it was just what I was looking for.  And another plus is the style, they look very nice hanging in my shower!

reviews.t: So much exfoliation and clean feeling!
reviews.x: I was excited to get this since I’ve been looking for a bath brush set for a while. The size is PERFECT. Reaches my back with the handle brush and is an amazing exfoliator. The hand brush is great for the whole body and I love it on my feet. The suds lather up quickly and keep going for only one use.  The built quality is excellent and exceeded my expectation. I didn’t use the suction holding cups since I have built in hooks but its a great thought to included them. I highly recommend this bath

Extremely rough on my skin. I cant use the hand one because it tore my skin up even applying as little pressure as I could. I bought this because I figured it would help me with skin build up, but I dont recommend unless you have alligator skin and a high pain tolerance.

reviews.t: I thought about keeping it until…
reviews.x: I recently moved to a different city and needed to get a new brush scrub for when I shower. I really liked my old one, but it was about time to get a new one and I figured I would grab one after the move so there would be less things to pack. I found my old one at a Ralph’s grocery store so I figured I’d be able to do that, but as it turns out buy one in stores is next to impossible. I tried at least 3 different stores I thought I’d be able to find one in and nada.  Feeling fed up I decided to g

Absolutely in love with my brush set! Since my recent surgery I’ve been dry brushing and wow the difference! This brush set is is very sturdy to reach difficult areas of my body yet gentle enough not to tear my skin and omg the itching I feel from the inside is the worst but when I’m dry brushing I swear it almost feels better than s*x. It’s something about the bristles and the way it rubs the skin that it actually relieves the inside itching and stimulates the lymph glands! Price point is perfe

Both brushes are of good quality. They soften up a little after a couple of uses but still retain some hardness which is good for exfoliating. I love the large brush as it is great for your back for sure. The small brush is great for the rest of your body and the little strap for your hand definitely helps. I did notice the string for extra grip on the large brush has come loose a little after some use, but it is still holding on.

The brushes are very nice. The hooks to hold them on the wall are worthless. If the hooks had been any good at all, they would have gotten 5 stars. I thoroughly cleaned the wall, then wiped it down with alcohol. Nothing could get the hooks to stay up even without anything hanging on them. I went to the dollar store and bought a couple of suction cups. Those work well.

For a bath scrubby, I'd have thought these would be made out of a naturally mold/mildew impervious wood.  Both the long handle and the brush have started to grow black mold within only 2 months of use.  We've tried vinegar and bleach.  Neither killed it.  These will be going in the trash.

reviews.t: Great scrub brush - no bristles Lost
reviews.x: Both brushes work well! They aren’t soft which j like. I wanted more of an exfoliating brush and this is perfect for that. I was concerned that the bristles would fall out - so far I loss one stand with each use - which to be isn’t bad. (I’ve had other that shed way more!)

A few bristles came off in the first few uses but it does the job now.  The hooks have been up in the shower for over 2 weeks no issues.  Dry brushing ar night before bed promotes better sleeping and I notice I wake up with more energy, less pain and stiffness.

Two very nice brushes. They also come with stick on hooks for your wall, but I haven't used them. My only problem is the twine on the handle. It's a little rough when wet. Other than that, I really like it!

Product arrived on time and in good condition. Like the natural feel of bristles. Also love that these two items were bundled together as I’m not sure I would have chosen both but I am putting both to good use now. It came with sticker hook so it can be hung on wall inside shower - pretty nice although a surprise. The one thing I did not like is the brushes came wrapped in plastic inside the shipping box. I’m all for cleanliness, but hate extra plastic. Suggest the wrapper could be in paper?  Al

Pour boiling water over brushes and let them soak till water cools to soften bristles. They're too harsh on skin if you don't. Bristles are attached to a plastic disk and glued on wood like handle. Great for exfoliating skin. No need to purchase special exfoliating body washes. The back brush is on a straight stick. A curved design for the stick would make it easier/more efficient to control. My hand cramped up from holding the back brush. Overall, good product. Meets my needs.

This review asks about stretch and sheerness. I’m not quite sure how they reflect the quality of a bath brush. So far it is easy to use and seems to be sturdy. The suction hooks are a nice bonus keeping the brush up on the shower tiles, out of the way and letting it dry between uses. The second brush is great for hand washing , firm enough yet not harsh, important these days that require frequent hand washing. I got one for my mom and she likes it too.

The suction hooks are a nice bonus keeping the brush up on the shower tiles, out of the way and letting it dry between uses. The second brush is great for hand washing , firm enough yet not harsh, important these days that require frequent hand washing. I got one for my mom and she likes it too.

Perfect set. Love the long brush for back etc and small brush for legs and arms. The bristles are pretty stiff and a little rough but it’s the perfect amount of exfoliation in my opinion. Gives me brand new skin. Also I’ve been using regularly for about 3/4 weeks and haven’t had any bristle calls out. Good quality

reviews.t: Definitely for people with tough skin
reviews.x: I purchased this to smooth out some rough dead skin patches. It pretty much just scratches really hard which feels good on tougher skin but could definitely be really rough on any softer areas of skin. Doesn’t really help remove any dead skin that I’ve noticed it pretty much just scratches and lathers soap around.

This is exactly what I wanted for dry brushing. The bristles are coarse and sturdy while still being pretty soft. Only downside is the string wrapped around the handle of the brush started unraveling after the first time I used it, but that wasn’t a surprise really and doesn’t change how the brush works.

Love this brush set!  The bristles do come off, but it’s ok.  There are plenty more.  This is ideal for dry-brushing and a dry massage.  Helps with circulation (nerve damage here!) and is incredibly relaxing.  I appreciate that I have two- one for personal and one for help.  Feels great!

Just got the set and I would set it's nice, BUT the bristles in the back brush are VERY course. I couldn't use the brush for more than 10-20 seconds because they're very firm. Other reviews said the bristles are boar hair, which I've not used before, so I'm not sure if this is typical.

Great pieces. Wash before use to remove any residue. I didnt at first try and my skin did not like it. But all good after a good soap and water wash. My circulation has improved but no stretch marks or scars have changed from dermabrasion. Leaves my skin fresh and soft after a shower.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the brushes provide strong, effective exfoliation and leave skin feeling clean.
Several reviewers praise the two-brush set, especially the long handle for reaching the back and the smaller hand brush for the rest of the body.
Some reviewers report bristles falling out, though a few note it was minor or stopped after initial uses.
A few reviewers find the bristles too rough or harsh on their skin.
Some reviewers report problems with the included hooks not staying up, and one reports black mold growing on the brushes.
